Please rebase and fix merge conflicts.  .clang-tidy needs to be simplified to an accepted (common in docs) but many of these fixes can be applied without clang-tidy enablement.

I don't really have a problem with most of these changes, but it is a little hard to gauge the appropriateness when there isn't any visibility into what we're enforcing against.  Hopefully you're planning to update the docs .clang-tidy with your proposed items we should be enforcing?

The tidy file I enforced against was in patchset 1..... that I broke out because you asked me to 😊

I'm happy to do whatever.  Right now the tidy file I used is in the second patchset in the series.  Yes, I fully support a common tidy file, and can make proposals at some point.

What I said in PS1 was:

>  .clang-tidy needs to be simplified to an accepted (common in docs)...

I didn't say it needed to be removed.  When I had reviewed this on June 26th, https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-pid-control/+/81469 wasn't available either.
Yep, I was going off "but many of these fixes can be applied without clang-tidy enablement." but you're right, that didnt' explicitly ask for splitting out.
